# STC Marketing

> STC Marketing is a web design and development company that designs, builds, integrates, and manages premium custom websites for businesses across the United States. Based in Oregon; works with clients nationwide through a fully remote process.

## Services

- **Custom website design and development** (primary service) — Premium websites designed and built from scratch, never from templates or page builders. Every build includes mobile-first responsive layouts, fast load times, on-page SEO and structured data, integrations with the client's business tools, hosting and domain management, security and software updates, and ongoing support after launch.
- **Website integrations** — Connects sites to the software a business runs on: Jobber for scheduling and client management, OpenTable for restaurant reservations, lead and quote forms delivered to email, Google reviews, and analytics. Also builds custom features such as client logins, audio and media players, before-and-after sliders, and interactive tools.
- **The Spotlights** (secondary) — A shared 9x12" direct mail postcard featuring multiple businesses, mailed to 5,000 households in Newberg, Oregon. One business per industry on each card.

## Service area

Nationwide. Based in Oregon, with clients in Oregon and across the country (including New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania). All work can be done remotely.
